facts.fact: Postmaster General John Tonui says Posta Kenya is developing a proposed National Digital Address Infrastructure combining postal data with geospatial mapping and verified digital addresses for banks, e-commerce firms and government agencies.

KEN.note: No government e-procurement system is mentioned.
No central bank role is stated.
No consumer protection rule or redress body is stated.
Only a general mention of e-government in the transformation agenda; no service, portal or count is stated.
PostaPay disbursements are a product feature; no government payment to people is stated.
No survey of adult account ownership is cited.

facts.fact: Postmaster General John Tonui says PostaPay, which takes payments by mobile app or USSD, is interoperable with mobile money wallets and banks.

KEN.note: No tax or fee payment to the state is stated.
